Ruling: batch #150 item 4 · letter c (the 「no anchor configured」 trade stands, now with its measured cost attached; card closed) · maintainer 「9609 关闭」 2026-09-17T15:35Z

Director seat, summon #24, `session_01Wj1HUjzyeiBQ8atRf1ZhaL`. First presented with option **a** (open a `tracking` anchor issue and have the maintainer set the repository variable `HALF_STATE_ANCHOR_ISSUE`); the maintainer agreed, and the seat then found — and put back to the maintainer — a prior ruling it had missed when presenting: on 2026-09-09 the maintainer closed objectui#7852 and objectui#5986, which asked for exactly that action, with 「7852 太麻烦,直接关闭」, and objectui#8740 then made the no-anchor configuration a supported one. Re-asked with that in view, the maintainer answered 「9609 关闭」.

Facts (this card; triage 5716039435): the detector already exists and runs — `H4` in `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` fires on every open `pm:blocked` card with no `Blocked-by:` line in body or comments, and `half-state-patrol.yml` runs it on schedule (100 runs, latest green). What is missing is delivery: with no anchor configured the findings go to the run summary, which the workflow itself says notifies nobody. Measured population: 66 open `domain:ui` + `pm:blocked` cards (triage re-read 67), of which **14 (21%, median age 14 days)** carry no unlock line under the repository's own tolerant reader — a residual bounded by a wider probe (identical 52 hits, symmetric difference empty), so it is not a spelling artefact. objectui#9164 among them carries `pm:blocked` with no blocker recorded anywhere.

## Ruling — **c**

- The 2026-09-09 decision stands: objectui configures no anchor. This card attaches the number that decision costs — 14 cards, 21%, median 14 days — and closes. ⛔ No second detector (it would detect the same thing into the same void), ⛔ no other delivery channel (that is development the maintainer has declined twice).
- The findings remain readable where the trade put them: each run's summary, and any seat may run `node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` itself at patrol time; the H4 rows are the same either way.
- ⛔ **a** — refused by the maintainer on 2026-09-09 and again today; ⛔ **b** — development.

Four-facet reading: ① zero customers; fleet PM hygiene; ② the maintainer's stated configuration for this install; ③ not scored — fleet-internal; ④ nothing added.

## Execution

`needs-user-decision` removed; closed **not_planned**. `priority:p1`, `tooling`, `domain:devx` stay as the record. objectui#9164 (blocked with no blocker recorded) is left to the `domain:ui` seat's next patrol, ⛔ not re-filed here.
